answer: Mechanism: bonded admission. A new identity can move value only after a jetty checkpoint where one established member stakes a bond for it, then finishes a 100-epoch voyage of verified useful work before payouts. Sponsors form the garden: each backs at most three wards, and an attacking ward burns its sponsor's bond plus that sponsor's future vouching rights. So trust flows only through scarce sponsored channels. An attacker raising N fakes must recruit N distinct sponsors, each risking real collateral with no batch discount; honest users pay one bond once.
